steps.title: A text box with a list attached
steps.titleZh: 带着建议列表的输入框
steps.text: This is a combobox: a text box with a list of suggestions attached, marked up so that screen readers know how the two belong together. When the page loaded, one `fetch` read the 11 topics in `topics.json`. The list is still hidden, and the input says so with `aria-expanded="false"`.
steps.textZh: 这是一个 combobox（组合框）：带建议列表的输入框，它的标记让屏幕阅读器知道两者是怎样配合的。页面加载时，用一次 `fetch` 读取了 `topics.json` 里的 11 个主题。列表现在还是隐藏的，输入框用 `aria-expanded="false"` 表明了这一点。

steps.title: Type to filter
steps.text: On every keystroke the list shows the topics that contain the typed text, ignoring upper and lower case. This button types `SCRIPT` in capitals, and two topics match. Each suggestion is added with `textContent`, so a topic is always shown as text and never read as HTML.
steps.textZh: 每按一次键，列表就显示包含所输入文字的主题，不区分大小写。这个按钮输入全大写的 `SCRIPT`，有两个主题匹配。每条建议都用 `textContent` 添加，所以主题永远按纯文本显示，不会被当成 HTML 解析。

steps.title: The arrow keys move a highlight
steps.text: The down arrow moves a highlight through the list and wraps around at the end. This button types `SCRIPT` again and presses ↓ three times: the first topic, the second, then the first again. The highlighted option gets `aria-selected="true"`, and the input points to it with `aria-activedescendant`, so the focus can stay in the box while a screen reader follows the highlight.
steps.textZh: 下方向键在列表里移动高亮，到末尾会绕回来。这个按钮重新输入 `SCRIPT`，再按三次 ↓：先是第一个主题，然后第二个，接着又回到第一个。高亮的选项带有 `aria-selected="true"`，输入框用 `aria-activedescendant` 指向它，这样焦点可以一直留在输入框里，屏幕阅读器也能跟上高亮的位置。

action.run: const input = document.querySelector('#query'); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) input.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'ArrowDown', bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));

steps.title: Enter picks the topic
steps.text: Enter picks the highlighted topic: the box fills in, the text below names it, and the list closes. Clicking a suggestion does the same.
steps.textZh: Enter 选中当前高亮的主题：输入框被填好，下方文字显示它的名字，列表随之关闭。直接点击建议也是一样。

action.run: document.querySelector('#query').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));

steps.title: Escape closes the list
steps.text: Escape, or moving the focus away from the box, closes the list without choosing anything. This button types `css`, which matches **CSS Grid**, then presses Escape.
steps.textZh: 按 Escape，或者让焦点离开输入框，列表就会关闭，什么也不选。这个按钮输入 `css`（它匹配 **CSS Grid**），再按 Escape。

action.run: document.querySelector('#query').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Escape', bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));

steps.title: Try it by hand
steps.text: Type in the **Topic** box yourself, then use the arrow keys, Enter and Escape. Click a suggestion with the mouse: each suggestion cancels its own `pointerdown`, so the box keeps the focus and the click picks the topic.
steps.textZh: 亲手在**主题**输入框里输入，再试试方向键、Enter 和 Escape。用鼠标点击一条建议：每条建议都会取消自己的 `pointerdown`，所以输入框保留焦点，这次点击就能选中主题。
